impact: VAL-CAP-004: 76.94% frame drop rate on NVENC/SHM/1080p60. Root cause CONFIRMED: XR24→NV12 software conversion averages 74.4ms/frame against a 16.7ms/60fps budget (4.46× over). Six GOPs measured (120 frames each), all consistent: mean_us 73497–75077, max_us 76797–83842. The convert_packed_bgra_to_nv12 call in nvenc/mod.rs is the bottleneck. Fix: replace software conversion with NVENC-native NV12 input path, or hardware-accelerated conversion (CUDA/VAAPI).
title: VAL-CAP-004 drop rate regression: consistent 77% frame drops on NVIDIA/SHM/1080p60 in T-010c smoke run (was 0% in T-021 rerun-27)
